nodes.author: DevanshuGulati5
nodes.text:
@Thinkerks @Bullmkt2022 @drakchaurasia @drcovidguru @amareshskumar @Aguirre1Gustavo It is not unusually severe illness. Prognosis is good in those children without any co morbidities (like congenital heart diseases, immunodeficiency, undernourished), without sequelae.
 I think hype zyada hai. Baaki time will tell.

Rest Chaurasia sir and Dharmendra sir will be able to tell better🙏
